lastCompletedStory.title: Bound and mode-restrict the codex instructions file across the whole dispatch lifecycle

openQuestions: Real production wiring gap (documented in patterns.md, not blocking this story's ACs): CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv only returns the rendered shell string, never the written instructions-file path, so loop.ts/review.ts do NOT call the new removeCodexInstructionsFile at their real dispatch-terminal chokepoint (worker-dispatch.ts's removeWorkerTaskPrompt, which they DO call for the task-prompt-file half of every dispatch). Reap-before-write (scoped to each agent+pid's own leaf dir) already bounds accumulation to at most one file per agent for the life of the long-running supervisor process, and mode 0o600 already closes the confidentiality half of the bug regardless of wiring, but a real 'zero survives immediately after THIS dispatch's worker exits' guarantee in production still needs a follow-up: either a path-returning seam on BackendAdapter, or threading agentName+pid through WorkerDispatchLifecycleOptions so worker-dispatch.ts can call removeCodexInstructionsFile unconditionally (no-op on the claude backend, which never writes one). Not filed as a separate CAM issue by this dispatch; next dispatch or the operator should judge whether it merits its own story or is acceptable residual risk given AC5's grep-scoped-to-backend-adapter.ts and AC6's self-contained test already both pass.
nextStoryContext: US-003 (Site 3 of 5, CAM-510, codex instructions file, the largest leak site by volume) is fully implemented and verified DONE. src/supervisor/backend-adapter.ts's writeCodexInstructionsFile (private) now writes under a dedicated, bounded, fixed-parent directory: tmpdir()/cam-cli-codex-instructions/<agentName>/<pid>/<uuid>.md (never the literal '/tmp', so a test can redirect via process.env.TMPDIR; still outside .claude/ so the plan preflight clean-tree guard, ADR-0014, never sees it). Before every write it reaps (readdirSync + rmSync) every prior sibling in THAT agent+pid's own leaf directory only (GOTCHA 8: never a different agent's dir, never the shared parent), mirroring writeTaskPromptFile's exact reap-then-write shape (task-prompt-file.ts:26-32, no second lifecycle invented) rather than US-001/US-002's prune-by-age variant (reap-all-before-write is correct here because a codex instructions file is single-owner per agent+pid, same justification task-prompt-file.ts documents). Writes with { mode: 0o600 } (verified via statSync in the test, not just asserted): closes the confidentiality bug where the reviewer branch's up-to-200KB injected git-diff body (CAM-354) was previously world-readable at 0o644. A new export, removeCodexInstructionsFile(agentName, uuid, pid = process.pid), mirrors removeTaskPromptFile's terminal-cleanup half of the task-prompt-file pattern (rmSync with force:true, idempotent). CodexAdapter.renderActor was threaded with a new required uuid parameter (all 4 call sites in buildSpawnArgv's switch updated to pass opts.uuid) so writeCodexInstructionsFile can key the filename by dispatch uuid instead of a randomUUID() (removed the now-unused node:crypto randomUUID import). AC5 grep oracle (readdirSync + 0o600 substrings in backend-adapter.ts) verified passing directly. AC6 test/supervisor/codex-instructions-reap.test.ts (3 tests, TMPDIR redirected via createTestTmpdir + restored in try/finally, task-prompt-file's own claudeDir pinned to a SEPARATE scratch dir per test so its independent already-bounded lifecycle doesn't pollute the codex-instructions topology assertions, never imports tmpdir from node:os) verified 3/3 pass: (a) full dispatch -> exactly one top-level entry under the redirected temp root while alive, file mode statSync-verified 0o600, non-empty content, then removeCodexInstructionsFile -> file gone, second idempotent call does not throw; (b) reap-before-write -> a second same-agent dispatch removes the first dispatch's file even though its own terminal removal was never called, leaf dir ends with exactly one entry; (c) GOTCHA 8 scoping -> a reviewer dispatch's terminal removal never touches a concurrently-live implementer dispatch's file for the same process. Pre-existing test/supervisor/codex-adapter.test.ts had one assertion updated (it hardcoded instructionsFile.startsWith('/tmp/'), which broke once production moved off the literal '/tmp' onto tmpdir()-derived paths, since this repo's real tmpdir() resolves to /var/folders/... on macOS, not /tmp); now asserts the path contains the new fixed parent name and still excludes '.claude/' -- all other assertions in that 42-test file were unaffected and still pass. Documented, but NOT wired, in this story: loop.ts/review.ts's real dispatch-terminal chokepoint (worker-dispatch.ts's removeWorkerTaskPrompt) does not yet call removeCodexInstructionsFile, because buildSpawnArgv's return type (a rendered shell string) never exposes the written path/identity to those callers; this is documented as an openQuestion and in the new patterns.md bullet, not filed as a separate CAM issue by this dispatch. All gates verified green this dispatch: typecheck clean, full bun test 6082 pass / 0 fail, embed-vendor:check clean (no vendor/templates touched but check:all still ran it), full bun run check:all spine green (lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/test-tmpdir/skip-ratchet all ok, no file-size budget raise needed). Appended a patterns.md bullet contrasting reap-all-before-write (single-owner-per-key resources, this site + task-prompt-file.ts) vs prune-by-age (potentially-concurrent-across-processes resources, US-001/US-002 sites) and documenting the production-wiring gap explicitly. Site 4 and 5 of 5 (per the CAM-510 issue spec) remain; branch is clean, committed, pushed by this dispatch's final step.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed fs.writeFileSync's { mode } option is a POSIX-style permission request applied at creation time subject to the process umask (effective mode = mode & ~umask), default 0o666 when omitted. For the 0o600 value used here this is a non-issue in practice: 0o600 has no group/other bits set for any typical umask (022/002/077/etc) to strip, so mode & ~umask === 0o600 regardless of the host's umask -- confirmed empirically in this session by statSync(...).mode & 0o777 === 0o600 passing in test/supervisor/codex-instructions-reap.test.ts against the real filesystem, not a mock.
